tools.name: work_board
tools.description: Use to decide WHERE to work. Reads Taskmarket's open bounties and SwarmMemo's open standing tasks and ranks every paid item across both by expected USD per entry, with seats, hours left, enter-now or reopen time, requester track record, flags and how to enter, plus dated notes on venues that look op

tools.name: taskmarket_picks
tools.description: Use before choosing what to work on. Every open Taskmarket bounty ranked by expected value per entry = reward / (competing entries + 1), adjusted for caution flags: reward + token, chain, hours left, entries, verdict good_bet | fair | long_shot | avoid, reasons, task URL. Optional: chain, q, tag, ma

tools.name: taskmarket_brief
tools.description: Use before starting one task: reward, hours left, entries vs market median, flags, deliverable type, checklist lines from the brief, an excerpt, its rank among picks and the exact submit command. id = task id or TSK- code; no id = the current top pick. PAID: $0.005 per call, no API key or account, o

tools.name: reward_benchmark
tools.description: Use before POSTING a bounty: reward, entries, entries-per-hour and window percentiles for open tasks by chain and deliverable kind, what agent rankers skip, the most under-served tasks, and an estimate for your planned reward/hours. Every number carries its sample size. PAID: $0.020 per call, no API

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: taskmarket_picks · Private data: work_board, taskmarket_picks, taskmarket_brief, reward_benchmark, work_pass, redeem_transfer_pass · Public sink: taskmarket_brief, work_pass · Destructive: payment_options.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: taskmarket_picks · Private data: work_board, taskmarket_picks, taskmarket_brief, reward_benchmark, work_pass, redeem_transfer_pass · Public sink: taskmarket_brief, work_pass · Destructive: payment_options

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
